targets.name: Training Dummy
targets.description: No defense or resistances. Shows your raw output, so it is the fairest way to compare two characters.

targets.name: Endgame Boss (generic)
targets.description: A stand-in for a level 45 dungeon boss. Boss stats live on NCSOFT's servers, so every value here is an estimate until DPS-meter data calibrates it.
targets.source: Community estimates: 25% crit damage tolerance and 30% double resist (gameplay.tips); defense, crit resist and damage tolerance are placeholders.
